subject.title: feat(kimi): show code quota in usage status

question: Should OpenClaw bundle authenticated Kimi Coding subscription-quota polling and status display under the existing provider-owned usage pattern?
rationale: The patch is technically aligned with the current plugin seam, but whether OpenClaw should make this vendor-specific subscription endpoint part of bundled status behavior is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Accept bundled Kimi quota status
options.body: Treat Kimi Coding like the existing provider-owned usage integrations and merge the managed-endpoint-only implementation.

options.title: Keep Kimi usage external
options.body: Decline bundled quota polling and direct the capability to the Kimi provider package or a separately sponsored plugin direction.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Kimi quota status
recommendation.body: Treat Kimi Coding like the existing provider-owned usage integrations and merge the managed-endpoint-only implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history ties steipete to both the Kimi provider boundary and shared provider-usage design.
